caption:
Your AI agent is not the only thing getting credit for that resolved ticket. 👇

Two support teams can run the exact same AI agent and still get completely different ROI numbers. Not because the agent performed differently. 📊

One team built a strong knowledge base and tight macros, so every ticket it touches gets split credit between the agent and that tooling.

The other team lets the agent wing every answer alone, so it keeps full credit on paper even when the actual quality is lower.

The dashboard rewards whichever team hands out credit less carefully, not whichever team actually runs the better operation. 🧠

That is the attribution problem hiding behind most AI agent ROI slides, and it is why comparing two teams by that number alone is a trap.

Save this so you have the answer ready before your next ROI review. 📌 And if your dashboard still hands the agent full credit every time, tell us in the comments. 💬
